text: Beth's husband Owen has [shot himself in the boat on the lake|trigger|losing family], leaving a note that says there is nothing, and nothing is after her. Drinking alone in the lakeside house he built, she finds a reversed floor plan, then photos on his phone of [women who look like her|archetypes|The Double], and across the water [a reversed copy of their home|images|the house and its rooms]. Something invisible moves through the rooms at night, and it [reaches for her wearing Owen's likeness|rules|it wears a familiar face].
